method: Actual Godot 4.6.3 updated production Rules and CarrierRoute export, then 120 Hz heading/rate-limit/hysteresis and 37 pickup-turn samples. Source-alpha foot-pad hulls plus bounded all-phase shader displacements: both weighted groups cannot exceed the stride convex hull. Contains current 3/4/6 visible leg metadata. No body, antennae, carried-ball, or whole-sprite ellipse used as foot contacts. Half-pixel AA pad is already deducted.

nest_gateway_board.hopper_note: The carrier route ends at nest; there is no carrier route continuation to the hopper. A separate visible transfer is not established by this geometry audit.

limitations: Every resource target is covered, but this is not exhaustive enumeration of all 2^240 possible occupancy topologies.
The walkable polygon is a declared geometry contract, not a segmented ground texture mask.
Dragon distance is to its baked centerline, not a tested visible alpha silhouette or temporal collision.
Foot pixels and sphere image overlap are depth/occlusion questions; no full 3D collision volume is defined here.
120 Hz plus one-frame movement allowance covers this fixed-speed geometric sample, not independent real-device frame jitter, upgraded movement, or human visual gait acceptance.
